description: Whether quota arithmetic, Stripe state and cost accounting all agree.

metrics.description: Workspaces whose displayed remaining questions differ from the ledger-derived figure.
metrics.measurementMethod: Recompute remaining as plan allowance plus purchases plus applicable adjustments minus billable usage in the cycle, and compare against the served value.

metrics.description: Occasions on which consumed usage was edited rather than an adjustment appended.
metrics.measurementMethod: Assert the usage ledger is append-only for billable rows: no updates or deletes against rows outside the current transaction.

metrics.description: Subscriptions whose local state disagrees with Stripe.
metrics.measurementMethod: List active Stripe subscriptions and compare status, price and period against the local mirror.
metrics.standardReference: Companion rule: local subscription state must be explainable by a Stripe object. Stripe publishes no threshold for this.

metrics.description: State changes caused by replaying a Stripe event that was already processed.
metrics.measurementMethod: Deliver the same signed event twice and assert no additional subscription, payment or quota row appears.
metrics.standardReference: Stripe: webhooks are delivered at least once and must be handled idempotently.

metrics.description: Difference between the ledger's summed cost and the figure shown on the admin dashboard.
metrics.measurementMethod: Sum estimated cost from the usage ledger for the window and compare against the dashboard aggregate, allowing only floating-point rounding.

metrics.description: Mean provider cost of one recipient question.
metrics.measurementMethod: Answer-model cost over the window divided by billable questions, priced from the central pricing table.
